name: /help
description: Ask the backend for command help or general usage guidance.

name: /model
description: Switch or inspect the active model if the backend supports it.

name: /system
description: Send an instruction that should be interpreted as a system-level directive.

name: /clear
description: Request backend-side context reset while keeping local history intact.

name: /reset
description: Ask the backend to reset the current session or thread.

name: /config
description: Query or adjust backend configuration through slash-command forwarding.

name: /save
description: Ask the backend to persist current work if it supports named sessions.

name: /load
description: Ask the backend to restore a saved session or preset.
